No pages cited: print start p. 155 and next chapter (Baddeley et al.) at p. 175, and the e-book range 169-188 minus the +14 offset gives 155--174, but no source states the end page (suggested pages 155--174). Entry is @inbook; house form for this is @incollection. The T&F e-book (2013, doi 10.4324/9780203772331) is a scan of the 1991 edition but its chapter metadata pages are offset by +14 from the printed page numbers, so its page ranges are not the print pages; print start pages come from the 1991 contents page in the preview PDF.
